present.label: Read the input
present.story: A staircase of {n} steps, climbed 1 or 2 steps at a time.
present.formal: n = {n}. Count sequences of 1s and 2s summing to n.

base.label: Write the first notes
base.story: There is 1 way to stand on the ground and 1 way to reach step 1.

fill.label: Write a note
fill.story: Step {i} is reached by one step from step {prev} ({oneBack} ways) or two steps from step {prev2} ({twoBack} ways): {oneBack} + {twoBack} = {value}.

done.label: Read the top note
done.story: The note on step {n} says {ways} ways.
